description: Dispatch keyboard key event, shortcut combination (Enter, Tab, Escape, F1-F12, Control+A, Control+C, Control+V, Control+X, Control+Z...), or an ordered sequence of keys to the active element or selector. Supports native editing commands (selectAll, copy, paste, cut, undo, redo), delayMs between keys, repeat count, inline post-key waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText, and includeSnapshot.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

delayMs.description: Optional delay in milliseconds between keys in a sequence (0..5000, default: 0)

includeSnapshot.description: Capture and return an interactive page snapshot after pressing key (default: false)

key.description: Key name, shortcut combination, or comma-separated sequence (e.g., 'Enter', 'Control+A', 'Ctrl+a, Backspace, 1, 2, 3, Enter')

keys.description: Optional ordered array of keys or combinations to press in sequence (e.g., ['Ctrl+a', 'Ctrl+v', '1', '2', '3', 'Enter'])

repeat.description: Optional number of times to repeat the key or key sequence (1..100, default: 1)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after pressing key

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after pressing key

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after pressing key

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after pressing key
